ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels and 30% high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant black central region extending from the base through the notch. High-intensity white mottling is concentrated on the distal half of the right lobe, featuring a large contiguous white area with dark spotting. The left lobe is predominantly dark with isolated white clusters at the tip and along the upper trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 65 degrees at the central vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with continuous small-scale serrations. The right lobe shows higher frequency serrations with pixel amplitudes of 3-7 pixels. The left lobe exhibits larger, more rounded indentations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Both lobes follow a convex upward curve from the notch to the tips, with the right lobe showing a more acute upward taper.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity white circular pixels located at the distal tips of both lobes and along the upper margin of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, unaligned light-grey linear streaks are visible on the dark pigmentation of the lower-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular jaggedness at the fluke tips consistent with parasitic attachment; distinctive white rake-mark scarring on the lower-left portion of the dark central pigment.
